name: throwable-highlighter-vscode-prototype
description: Technical prototype of Throwable Highlighter for VS Code.

throwableHighlighter.prototype.classColo.description: Foreground color for Throwable types. Leave empty to preserve the native Java class color.

throwableHighlighter.prototype.importCol.description: Foreground color for Throwable types in explicit imports. Leave empty to inherit the class color.

throwableHighlighter.prototype.catchColo.description: Foreground color for Throwable types in catch parameters. Leave empty to inherit the class color.

throwableHighlighter.prototype.throwsCol.description: Foreground color for Throwable types in throws clauses. Leave empty to inherit the class color.

scripts.watch: npm run compile && concurrently --kill-others --names typescript,aliases "tsc -w -p tsconfig.json" "tsc-alias -w -p tsconfig.json"
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run compile && npm test
